messages:
Marta: Heads-up — while validating q4b-int8 bring-up I spotted holdout leakage from URL-normalization diffs. Sample: "Visit http://example.com/path" vs "http://example.com/path/" ended up in both pool and holdout.
Jin: ugh. is that from the tokenizer diff or our ingestion normalization? 
Marta: ingestion. we changed the normalizer to strip trailing slashes for dedupe but the holdout IDs were generated before that. So same canonical form maps to different sample IDs.
Ryan: ok that's plausible. How many affected? 
Marta: quick grep => ~1.2k across the 50k anchor set. mostly web-scrape longtail.
Ana: That's big for the golden set. For regressions we need deterministic canonicalization or remove those from holdout.
Marta: Proposal: run a one-off canonicalize pass on the whole pool, then re-evaluate holdout membership. I'll run with --dry-run first.
labeler-bot: Reminder: upcoming relabel window on Sat 03/15. Queue length: 432.
Jin: We should also add ambiguous instruction prompts to golden to catch Q-int8 hallucination drift. Examples: short terse asks like "Summarize" with no context.
Ryan: Agreed. Can you assemble ~200 diverse terse prompts (multilang and code snippets)? We'll reserve 50 for canary.
Ana: Ops question — does the q4b-int8 KVCACHE change affect our prefix dedupe? Seen slight token misalignments on longctx.
Marta: Yes, different chunking in the compiled kernel changes the way we compute fingerprint windows. So dedupe on token-level hash will shift. We should prefer semantic fingerprinting for the golden set.
Jin: For the sampling pipeline, here's the command I'll run (dry-run):
```
python tools/sample_bank.py --input pool.parquet --canon=slash-strip --fingerprint=semantic --holdout 0.05 --dry-run
```
Marta: After dry-run I'll push a job to run canonicalize + remap holdout. Expect ~90m runtime.
Ryan: Labeling ops: if we change holdout we'll need to pause the relabel window until new mapping is stable. Ana can you coordinate with ops? @Ana
Ana: On it. I'll move the relabel schedule to next weekend if needed and update the labeler handbook.
Marta: Also documenting edge cases: urls, whitespace-only prompts, and placeholder tokens like [USER_INPUT]. I'll open a short doc in docs/curation/golden-crosswalk.md
Jin: one more: add a canary for the quantized model where we compare top-k tokens on 512-step prefix; log diffs > 8% token-level disagreement.
Ryan: good metric. Let's meet after the remap to validate.
Marta: action items: (1) Marta run canonicalize dry-run (2) Jin assemble terse prompt bank + canary (3) Ana coordinate relabel window (4) Ryan set token-disagreement alert. Ping me with links.
Ana: noted. I'll update the calendar and post a follow-up in #eng-ml when schedule changes.
labeler-bot: Queued: relabelers notified: 24. ETA: 48h once confirmed.
Marta: thanks team :thumbsup:
